statement: A byte string containing a float written at less than 64-bit precision is not decoded
deviation: Wrote 1.0 as major 7, ai=26 (single precision). DAG-CBOR always requires 64 bits.

control.note: IPLD's canonical form (64 bit). gx refuses this one too -- because 42 §2.1-4 places no floats in canonical structures. One of the two cases where the control does not become ACCEPT, and that very difference is why the P-1 vector exists
